description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableAttributes' implementing the 'Attributes' interface, providing methods to manipulate JSON-based attributes, including creation, access, modification, and serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableAttributes
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Attributes interface, providing JSON attribute manipulation.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns a new empty Attributes instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Attributes instance initialized with data from a given JsonObject, validating keys.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a boolean.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a number.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is an integer.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a long.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a double.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a string.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is an object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is an array.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is null.

methods.name: asBoolean
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a boolean.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as an int.

methods.name: asLong
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a long.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a double.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a string.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a JsonObject.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a JsonArray.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a value for a given key with various data types, returning a new Attributes instance.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a field or multiple fields based on definitions or JsonField objects, returning a new Attributes instance.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key from attributes, returning a new Attributes instance.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the attributes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves JSON objects or values based on pointers, definitions, or selectors.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key or definition.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns a list of all keys.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonField for a given key.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the attributes are empty.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of attributes.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the JsonFields.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a stream of JsonFields.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the attributes.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Returns JSON with schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the object to a SerializationContext.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Returns an upper bound estimate for string size.
